Hannah (Design): Dropped a micro-proposal for making the Alert preview more explicit about who will actually get a notification in multi-tenant orgs. Main goals: surface masking, timezone clarity, and keyboard-first interactions. Mock: https://figma.redwood/preview-clarity (small screenshot). Leo (PM): Nice. Two product asks: (1) show whether channel targets are masked for viewer (e.g., 'masked') when the user lacks permission, and (2) make the preview permalink copy-safe so runbooks don't leak emails. Sung (Frontend): We can show a `masked` pill and only fetch full targets on-demand via a `View details` action that requires a permission check. Suggest API payload: `{policyId: "p-zzz", previewMode: "masked"}`. For keyboard, propose `k` hotkey to toggle preview panel and Up/Down to navigate rows. Eva (A11y): Hotkeys are great but must be discoverable. Add a small tooltip: "Press K to open preview" and expose the keybinding via a `aria-description` on the header. Also, when preview content changes (sort/filter), announce concise summaries via an `aria-live` region: "Preview updated: 3 targets visible, 1 masked." Use polite for non-critical updates. Pri (SRE): For debugging, include a `snapshot-age` badge if the preview used cached routing info. We've seen confusion when previews run off slightly stale data. Badge example: `Snapshot: 46s old`. If >2m, color it amber and add a hover explaining why it might be stale. Hannah (Design): Copy options: compact banner vs sentence. Draft banner: "Preview (snapshot 46s old): 2 will be notified • 1 masked • 0 suppressed". Leo prefers natural language: "Preview complete — two targets would be notified; one target is masked." Thoughts? Leo (PM): Natural language is friendlier. Use semicolons for clarity: "Preview complete — two targets would be notified; one is masked." Keep banner tappable to expand into full explainers. Sung (Frontend): Implementation note for SRs: the banner should have `role=region aria-live="polite"` and the expand control should be a `button aria-expanded="false"`. Example: `
Preview complete — two targets would be notified; one is masked.
` Eva (A11y): When expanding details, ensure focus moves to the detail container and that it has `role=dialog` only if it behaves like a modal. For an inline drawer, use `role=region` and `aria-labelledby` with a visible heading. Also, truncated reasons should have accessible full text via `aria-describedby`. Pri (SRE): Edge case: masked target might still be active in routing (we had an incident where masked pager targets caused confusion). Suggest the detail row shows `masked:true` and `targetStatus: notified|skipped|fallback` so engineers can tell whether masking hides only identity or also status. Hannah (Design): UI detail: row layout -> [region flag] [channel] [state chip] [reason single-line truncated] [last match small]. Tapping the row expands inline to show full rule provenance and a tiny "Run live check" button that re-evaluates against live config. We'll gate the live check behind rate limits. Leo (PM): Add a small CTA in the expanded row: "Open runbook" that links to project-specific runbook. Also ensure shareable URLs do not include full target identifiers unless explicitly requested. Default share: anonymized snapshot id. Sung (Frontend): We'll keep the client stateless by encoding filter/order in query params: `?snapshot=s-123&order=user&filter=notified`. Also add `?revealTargets=true` which requires a permission token to avoid accidental leaks. Example call: `/alerts/preview?snapshot=s-123&revealTargets=true` (server enforces perms). Eva (A11y): Color contrast check: state chips (notified green, suppressed gray, masked purple) must meet 4.5:1 for body text. For small chips, use an outline or icon in addition to color. Also ensure focus ring is clearly visible on the row when navigating via keyboard. Pri (SRE): Request: include a tiny event timestamp per row: `last_eval` and `last_match` so on-call can correlate. For canned summaries (e.g., runbook links) add a machine-friendly CSV export: `channel,state,reason,last_match,masked`. Hannah (Design): Will tweak mocks: swap purple for a higher-contrast hue, add clock hint beneath reason, and include a 'copy snapshot link' action that warns if sharing exposes targets. Also adding small help text under the hotkey tooltip: "K opens preview; Esc closes". Sung (Frontend): I'll spike the hotkey + keyboard nav and the masked-fetch flow. Plan: PR with accessibility notes and a short e2e test for the snapshot reveal permission. Eva (A11y): I'll review the PR for aria-live phrasing, focus flow, and color tokens. Quick text suggestion for the banner announcement: "Preview complete. Two targets would be notified; one target is masked from your view." It's explicit for SRs. devops-bot: preview build is live — https://preview.redwood/alerts/preview-clarity?branch=preview-clarity — run id: build-9821 Hannah (Design): Thanks, team. If no objections I'll land this as an opt-in feature flag next sprint. Please comment if we missed any privacy or a11y blockers. :thumbsup:
